name: Park Hyatt Seoul
positioning: Contemporary high-rise hotel in Gangnam near the COEX Convention center, with a 24th-floor lobby and a design by the Japanese firm Super Potato
best_for: Travelers who want a Gangnam base a short walk from Samseong Station
Families with infants who want baby food, baby gear rentals and babysitting on request

facts.text: The hotel is in Gangnam, near the COEX Convention center.
The hotel is a one-minute walk from Exit 1 of Samseong Station.
Bongeun temple, art galleries, shopping, outdoor parks and paths along the Han River are within easy reach.
The lobby is on the 24th floor, with high ceilings and contemporary Korean art.
Bedrooms are finished in pale oak, and bathrooms in rough Japanese stone and heavy marble.
Bathrooms have spa-inspired rain showers and spacious bathtubs.
The Presidential Suite is on the top floor, with panoramic city views and Korean accents.
Cornerstone, the main restaurant on the 2nd floor, serves Italian dishes.
Cornerstone offers a gift selection from Pierre Herme Paris, including macarons and chocolates.
The Timber House has live performances every evening.
Room service is available 24 hours a day.
The hotel offers stroller and baby bed rentals as well as babysitting services.

highlights.text: The Timber House is a whisky and cocktail bar, reached through a hidden passageway, that reinterprets Korean tradition through a contemporary lens.
The granite-lined indoor swimming pool is designed in an infinity pool style, with sunlight through floor-to-ceiling windows.
The Lounge serves contemporary Korean cuisine with seasonal ingredients and French cooking techniques, alongside traditional teas and a signature afternoon tea.
It was the first hotel from the Japanese architecture firm Super Potato.
Ocelas Spa at Park Club has three private treatment rooms and a citrus bar serving Korean-inspired refreshments.

considerations.text: One set of elevators runs between street level and the top-level lounge and another goes to the rooms, which can be slightly confusing.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
WhataHotel notes the formal atmosphere may not suit all leisure travelers.
